'''Kril'Dor''' was a [[Gas giant/Legends|gas giant]] [[Planet/Legends|planet]] that was located on the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]]. It was a known source of [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]].

==History==
[[File:KrilDor-JAcutscene.jpg|thumb|left|Kril'dor]]
The [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jaden Korr]] and [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] [[General/Legends|General]] [[Wedge Antilles/Legends|Wedge Antilles]] came to the planet in [[14 ABY/Legends|14 ABY]] on a [[Mission to Kril'Dor|mission]] to liberate a [[Tibanna/Legends|tibanna]] gas [[Mining/Legends|mining]] platform from the [[Disciples of Ragnos]], who was using profits from the mining and sale of the valuable gas to fund themselves. The mission was a success; Korr placed several [[Homing beacon/Legends|homing beacons]] in strategic points of the gas platform in order to lead Antilles to the targets and destroy them with [[Proton torpedo/Legends|proton torpedoes]] from his [[X-wing starfighter/Legends|X-wing starfighter]].

Korr first had to put beacons on the roofs of the [[Deflector shield generator/Legends|shield generator]] building, troop barracks, communications array, and [[TIE/ln space superiority starfighter/Legends|TIE Fighter]] [[Hangar/Legends|hangar]]. As the hangar was taken out, the Imperials were unable to send out air support against Antilles. There were several [[Turbolaser/Legends|turbolasers]] on various locations on the platform, but none managed to hit Antilles as he made his runs against his targets. A pair of proton torpedoes knocked out the power generator and disabled all turbolasers. Korr then had to place a beacon inside the command center. There he defeated one of the [[Sith cultist/Legends|Sith Cultists]] based on the platform in a [[Lightsaber duel/Legends|lightsaber duel]].

After the command center, the last target on the mission's agenda, was taken out, several squads of [[Stormtrooper/Legends|stormtroopers]] attempted to sabotage the tibanna gas storage tanks. Acting quickly, Korr disabled the bombs and defeated the remaining Imperial troops. Once the station was secured, the New Republic sent its own forces to repair and defend the installation from any further attacks by the Disciples of Ragnos.
